title: How does an LLM turn my question into an answer?
series: LLMs, one question at a time
description: An 8-page comic that follows one question about a cat through token IDs, sampling, weights, prefill, decode and KV caching.
intro: While learning how LLMs work, I kept coming back to a few questions. If the model only takes numbers, what happens to my text? Why can it process the question together, but generate the answer one token at a time? Does it process the whole question again at every step?
I turned that learning into this 8-page comic. It follows one question about a cat through token IDs, sampling, weights, prefill, decode and KV caching.

pages.heading: Why can it read faster than it can write?
transcript: Why can it read faster than it can write?
Prefill: known prompt positions can run in parallel. Decode: choices depend on earlier tokens.
Standard autoregressive Transformers. Runtimes may chunk prompts; optimized decoding adds variations.
